description: Дані про споживання електроенергії на полігоні ТПВ is a dataset listed in Open data portal of Ukraine (data.gov.ua), a national open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by Комунальне підприємство "Полігон ТПВ". Набір містить дані щодо споживання активної електроенергії на полігоні ТПВ. Coverage: Комунальне підприємство "Полігон ТПВ". The publisher named on the listing is Комунальне підприємство "Полігон ТПВ". Its keywords include активна електроенергія. The listing shows 5 download or service links in XLSX. The listing shows 2024-03-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ua-direct.
